severityNote: QA / design note (demoted from prior H-01). Re-adjudicated under the owner-driven-attacks-are-invalid rule at run phoenix-nft-staking-13: the permissionless vector is FIXED and the residual is owner-driven only.
title: Value-blind, count-gated full-pot nudge payout (QA design note; prior H-01 permissionless vector fixed by story-014)
description: Re-adjudication note (run phoenix-nft-staking-13, HEAD 031ffda): story-014 FIXED the run-12 permissionless High by owner-pinning both the minter and the dispatcherIndex, removing the caller's ability to select a cheap/zero-price dispatcher. There is no remaining permissionless, profitable drain of the nudge pot. The nudge payout in batchMint remains value-blind: the gate is purely count-based (_nudgeSize != 0 && count >= _nudgeSize, line 246) and, when cleared, transfers the full nudgePaymentToken balanceOf(this) to the recipient (lines 251-253) without comparing the payout to the value actually paid. The two residual ways to make that full-pot sweep cheaply profitable both require owner misconfiguration: (a) the owner pins a dispatcher whose price == 0 (free mints clear the count gate for ~zero token cost); (b) the owner over-funds the pot so that pot > nudgeSize * price (the swept pot exceeds the mint cost). Both are owner-driven and therefore INVALID per the owner-driven-attacks-are-invalid rule. Retained as a QA/design note: a value-aware payout cap would harden the contract against owner misconfiguration even though no permissionless exploit remains.
impact: None under the validity rules for this run. No permissionless, profitable drain exists after story-014. The residual value-blindness is only exploitable when the owner misconfigures the system (zero-price pinned dispatcher, or pot over-funded beyond nudgeSize*price), which is out of scope as an owner-driven attack. This is a hardening recommendation, not a High/Medium for this run.
attackPath: Not a valid standalone attack under the owner-driven-invalid rule.
Residual (a) - owner pins a dispatcher with price == 0: count gate clears at ~zero token cost and the full pot is swept. Requires owner misconfiguration => INVALID.
Residual (b) - owner over-funds the pot (pot > nudgeSize*price): the swept pot exceeds the amount paid. Requires owner misconfiguration => INVALID.
The permissionless caller-chosen-dispatcher vector that made the run-12 H-01 a valid High was FIXED by story-014 (owner-pinned minter + dispatcherIndex).
recommendation: Defense-in-depth (QA / optional hardening): make the nudge payout value-aware rather than purely count-gated so owner misconfiguration cannot be turned into a free/over-profitable sweep. Options: (1) gate the nudge on cumulative value actually paid (totalPaid) at/above a threshold rather than on count alone; (2) cap the nudge payout per call to a fixed or derived amount rather than sweeping the full balance; (3) enforce a minimum price > 0 on the pinned dispatcher. None of these are required to close a valid finding for this run; they harden against owner misconfiguration.

readjudication.verdict: Permissionless vector FIXED; residual sub-vectors (a) zero-price pinned dispatcher and (b) over-funded pot are owner-driven and INVALID. Demoted to QA/design note. NOT a valid High/Medium for run phoenix-nft-staking-13.
